executive_summary: The TESTING sub-agent (lib/sub-agents/testing/index.js:109 checkForNonUISdType, index.js:362-430) currently decides E2E applicability from a private hardcoded list, skipE2ESdTypes (index.js:376, 11 entries: database, infrastructure, documentation, docs, protocol, refactor, process, uat, orchestrator, api, backend). A match returns verdict PASS, confidence 95, with every phase marked skipped and phase5_verdict.auto_pass=true BEFORE any test runs. A second, divergent private list, E2E_EXEMPT_SD_TYPES (phase4-evidence.js:89, only 5 entries), disagrees with the first. Meanwhile the canonical policy module (scripts/modules/handoff/validation/sd-type-applicability-policy.js, getValidatorRequirement at :425, infrastructure.TESTING=NON_APPLICABLE at :175, plus a detectCodeProduction produces-code override at :79-99) already exists and is already consumed by mandatory-testing-validation.js (imported at line 20, used at :162) to decide REQUIRED vs ADVISORY tier when a TESTING row is MISSING. The gap this PRD closes is narrower than the SD's own SC#3 wording implies (independently measured at LEAD: mandatory-testing-validation.js currently returns ADVISORY passed:true/score:70 for a NOT_APPLICABLE code-changing SD, not ERR_TESTING_REQUIRED) -- the actual defect is that once a TESTING row EXISTS, the gate (mandatory-testing-validation.js:245) only checks verdict membership in [PASS, CONDITIONAL_PASS] plus staleness; it never inspects phase5_verdict.auto_pass or any measured signal, so a type-only auto-pass row satisfies the gate identically to a genuinely measured pass. This PRD: (1) deletes both private lists and routes the sub-agent's applicability decision through the one policy module; (2) when the policy says non-applicable-but-produces-code, RUNS the applicable non-UI validation and records real executed/passed/failed counts instead of fabricating PASS/95; (3) adds a first-class measured boolean to the verdict so PASS can never mean 'skipped'; (4) keeps the EXISTING advisory/required tiering UNCHANGED (per the SD's own NON-GOALS 'no new gate') -- an ADVISORY-tier SD that is unmeasured stays ADVISORY, it is simply no longer mislabeled PASS.

functional_requirements.title: Single source of applicability: delete the two private lists
functional_requirements.description: Delete skipE2ESdTypes (lib/sub-agents/testing/index.js:376) and E2E_EXEMPT_SD_TYPES (lib/sub-agents/testing/phases/phase4-evidence.js:89). checkForNonUISdType (index.js:362-430) and phase4-evidence.js's applicability check both call getValidatorRequirement(sdType, 'TESTING') from scripts/modules/handoff/validation/sd-type-applicability-policy.js instead, so the sub-agent and the mandatory-testing-validation.js gate read the same rule. Import path is clean and non-circular (mandatory-testing-validation.js already imports the same module at line 20).
acceptance_criteria: lib/sub-agents/testing/index.js and phase4-evidence.js both import getValidatorRequirement

The 5 sd_types previously exempt only in E2E_EXEMPT_SD_TYPES (protocol, api, backend, database, refactor, process) now resolve applicability via the same single policy call as the other 6 -- no code path re-derives its own subset

functional_requirements.title: Non-applicable-but-code-producing: run real validation instead of auto-pass
functional_requirements.description: When getValidatorRequirement resolves E2E as non-applicable for the sd_type AND detectCodeProduction (sd-type-applicability-policy.js:79-99) says the SD produces code, the TESTING sub-agent RUNS the applicable non-UI validation -- the repo unit/integration suite scoped to the changed files, or an SD-declared test command from smoke_test_steps/metadata -- and records executed, passed, and failed counts in the verdict. A verdict whose execution phase is skipped can never carry verdict=PASS: it is NOT_APPLICABLE (true docs-only, no code) or CONDITIONAL_PASS with a stated reason (code present but no scoped test command resolvable).
acceptance_criteria: Unit test: a code-changing infrastructure-type fixture SD with zero test runs never yields verdict PASS from checkForNonUISdType's replacement path
Unit test: the same fixture with a passing scoped unit run yields verdict PASS with executed>0, passed>0, failed=0
A docs-only fixture (no code diff) still yields the fast NOT_APPLICABLE path with no test execution attempted (byte-identical cost to today for that case)

functional_requirements.title: measured field on the verdict; gate treats an unmeasured row honestly, without adding a new blocking tier
functional_requirements.description: Add a top-level measured:boolean field to the TESTING sub-agent's verdict object and thread it into the sub_agent_execution_results insert (no such field exists today per Explore evidence). mandatory-testing-validation.js's existing ADVISORY/REQUIRED tiering (driven by getValidatorRequirement, unchanged by this SD per NON-GOALS 'no new gate') is preserved exactly: a REQUIRED-tier code-changing SD with a TESTING row whose measured=false is treated as ERR_TESTING_REQUIRED (absence of real evidence), same severity class the gate already uses today for a MISSING row -- this SD does not introduce a new severity tier, it closes the loophole where a present-but-fabricated row satisfied the existing REQUIRED check. An ADVISORY-tier SD (per current policy) with measured=false stays ADVISORY -- it is surfaced honestly (not silently PASS/95) but does not newly block, preserving the SD's own scope boundary.
acceptance_criteria: Unit test asserts verdict PASS implies measured=true and failed=0 (never PASS with measured=false)

Gate unit test: REQUIRED-tier code-changing SD + TESTING row with measured=false -> gate fails with the SAME ERR_TESTING_REQUIRED-class error the gate already raises for a missing row (no new error code / no new blocking tier introduced)
Gate unit test: ADVISORY-tier SD + TESTING row with measured=false -> gate still passes ADVISORY (score 70, as today), now carrying an honest measured=false rather than an implied-measured PASS
Gate unit test: any-tier SD + TESTING row with measured=true, verdict=PASS -> gate passes exactly as today

functional_requirements.title: Replay parity: QF-20260801-660 controlled pair
functional_requirements.description: Add a regression fixture replaying the QF-20260801-660 controlled pair (identical evidence, sd_type=bugfix vs sd_type=infrastructure) through the post-fix TESTING sub-agent and assert both runs produce the identical verdict object (modulo timestamps/ids) -- proving sd_type is no longer the discriminant.
acceptance_criteria: Two fixture SDs differing only in sd_type, same code diff, same (absence of) test evidence, produce byte-identical verdict/confidence/measured on replay

technical_requirements.title: No new sub-agent, no new gate, no schema migration
technical_requirements.description: All changes are within lib/sub-agents/testing/ and the sub_agent_execution_results JSONB payload (metadata.measured); no new table/column, no new sub-agent code, no change to the docs-only NON_APPLICABLE mapping, no change to evidence reuse (SD-FDBK-INFRA-TESTING-EVIDENCE-REUSE-001) or the verdict cache (QF-20260901-544), no widening of exemptions to bugfix.

risks.risk: Deleting E2E_EXEMPT_SD_TYPES without preserving its story-mapping exemption could regress QF-20260801-425 (90.5% of stories have e2e_test_path NULL)

risks.risk: Routing all 11 types through the single policy could silently flip currently-exempt types (protocol, api, backend) to a stricter tier than intended
risks.mitigation: Enumerate all 11 legacy-exempt types against the policy's current classification in a pinned unit test before merge, and flag any type whose effective tier changes for explicit sign-off

risks.risk: Interpreting SC#3 as 'introduce new blocking enforcement' rather than 'make the existing tiering honest' would conflict with the SD's own NON-GOALS ('no new gate') and widen blast radius beyond what LEAD approved
risks.mitigation: FR-3 explicitly preserves the existing ADVISORY/REQUIRED tiering; escalated to the coordinator via /signal prd-ambiguous 483264c3-3646-40ef-b557-85bf2d26a9c5 at LEAD, resolved in this PRD by keeping tiering unchanged and only fixing the measured/PASS conflation

implementation_approach.summary: Swap the private lists for the existing policy call, add a measured flag, run real scoped tests when applicable, and pin behavior with fixtures replaying the QF-20260801-660 pair.
steps: 1. Add getValidatorRequirement/detectCodeProduction imports to index.js and phase4-evidence.js
2. Replace skipE2ESdTypes/E2E_EXEMPT_SD_TYPES branches with policy calls; delete the two arrays
3. When non-applicable+code-producing, invoke the scoped test runner (repo unit/integration suite filtered to changed files, or an SD-declared test command) and capture executed/passed/failed
4. Add measured:boolean to the verdict object and to the sub_agent_execution_results insert
5. In mandatory-testing-validation.js, treat measured=false on a REQUIRED-tier row as evidence-absent (reuse the existing missing-row error path); leave ADVISORY-tier behavior unchanged
6. Add unit tests: TS-1 through TS-5, plus the all-11-types tier-parity enumeration from the risks section
7. Verify QF-20260801-425's story e2e-mapping exemption is preserved (TR-2)
